FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Begin a right turn from the far-right lane unless markings permit simultaneous right turns from multiple lanes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Do not swing left before making a right turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
Slow before a turn and finish in the appropriate lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A01
While waiting to turn left, keep the front wheels straight so a rear impact does not push the vehicle into opposing traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A01
Do not cut a left-turn corner so sharply that the vehicle enters the path of traffic approaching from the left. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A01
A marked left-turn-only lane permits only a left turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A01
Do not turn around on a hill or curve if approaching drivers cannot see the vehicle from five hundred feet in either direction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A01
A shared center turn lane serves left turns from either direction and cannot be used to pass. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0095]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A02
The guide limits travel within a shared center left-turn lane to two hundred feet. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A02
Before entering a shared turn lane, check ahead, check mirrors, signal left and check the left blind spot. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A02
Watch for traffic entering from driveways or side roads before making a left turn from the shared lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A02
Traffic moves counterclockwise around the center island of a roundabout. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A02
Traffic entering a roundabout yields to vehicles already circulating. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A02
Select the proper lane before entering a multilane roundabout. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R15 | anchor: A02
The guide directs drivers not to pass or change lanes inside a multilane roundabout. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R16 | anchor: A02
Follow roundabout signs and lane markings to the intended exit. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec11-R17 | anchor: A03
Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists at a roundabout as well as to circulating vehicles. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R18 | anchor: A03
Do not travel alongside a truck or bus in a roundabout. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R19 | anchor: A03
Use signals to communicate a planned turn, lane change, slowdown or stop. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R20 | anchor: A03
Signals may be communicated by vehicle lamps or the left arm. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R21 | anchor: A03
The guide requires a turn signal to continue for at least one hundred feet before the turn. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R22 | anchor: A03
Use a left signal when leaving a parallel curb space to enter traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R23 | anchor: A03
Use a left signal before moving left to pass another vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R24 | anchor: A03
Do not use a one-sided turn signal as an invitation for another vehicle to pass. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0097]

FACT_ID: sec11-R25 | anchor: A04
Extending the left arm straight outward signals a left turn. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R26 | anchor: A04
Bending the left arm upward signals a right turn. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R27 | anchor: A04
Bending the left arm downward signals slowing or stopping. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R28 | anchor: A04
Right-of-way rules identify who must yield; a driver should not insist on priority when doing so creates danger. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R29 | anchor: A04
At a yield sign, slow and stop if needed, then proceed only without interfering with approaching traffic. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R30 | anchor: A04
A left-turning driver yields to oncoming vehicles, including bicycles. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R31 | anchor: A04
For an emergency vehicle using a siren and warning lamps, pull to the right clear of intersections and stop until it passes. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R32 | anchor: A04
Watch for additional emergency vehicles after the first one passes. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R33 | anchor: A04
Yield to pedestrians lawfully crossing in marked or unmarked crosswalks. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R34 | anchor: A04
Yield to a pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane, including a cane with a red tip. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R35 | anchor: A04
At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to vehicles already in it. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R36 | anchor: A04
At a T junction, traffic entering from the ending road yields to traffic on the through road. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R37 | anchor: A04
A driver entering a paved road from an unpaved road yields to traffic on the paved road. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R38 | anchor: A04
When returning from parking or entering from an alley, driveway or roadside, yield to traffic on the main roadway. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec11-R39 | anchor: A04
At a four-way stop when vehicles arrive simultaneously, the driver to the left yields to the driver on the right. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0098]
